howToBook.stepsNote: Cut from five to three. Originals 1-2 were not steps, they were the website: browsing and choosing a date happen on the page itself. Originals 4-5 described one moment twice. Every original title and body is preserved verbatim in `stepsOriginal`, and each surviving step lists what it absorbed. The three retained titles are also the three the parity scan requires on the homepage.
howToBook.responsePromiseNote: A stated reply time is a claim about how the business actually operates. It stays null and the line is omitted from the page entirely until the client supplies a real number. Never fill this in from research or assumption.
howToBook.deckNote: Copy deck applied by MEANING, not by position. The deck was written against the original five steps; these are the three that survived the collapse, so a positional mapping put "We confirm everything" above a body that reads "Contact us via message or email with..." — a title contradicting its own verbatim body. Deck line 1 ("Tell us the day") fits step 1 exactly. Step 2 takes "Send us the details", which is not a deck line and is FLAGGED in MORNING.md. Step 3 merges deck lines 2 and 3 because its body merged the original steps 4 and 5.

positioning.statement: A family runs this. That is the whole difference.
positioning.body: Two brothers and the roads they grew up on. No group of forty, no timetable to keep, no commentary you could have read online. You tell us the day you want, and we drive it.
